title: Mixing Colors for Kids! Make Orange, Green and Purple
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're mixing colors to make brand new ones!
I put on my lab goggles, and I'm ready to learn something new with you.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: red and yellow are going to mix! Can you guess?
Red plus yellow makes... Orange! Can you say orange?
Look! A red drop, plus a yellow drop, makes an orange drop!
Swirl, swirl, swirl! The two colors mix together.
Can you stir a big pretend paint pot? Round and round and round!
Can you guess? What other things are orange?
An orange, a carrot, and a big round pumpkin!
One more time, nice and loud: ORANGE! Great job!
Red and yellow make orange. What a magic mix!
Here's a clue: blue and yellow are going to mix! Can you guess?
Blue plus yellow makes... Green! Can you say green?
Look! A blue drop, plus a yellow drop, makes a green drop!
Swirl, swirl, swirl! Blue and yellow mix together.
Can you hop like a little green frog? Hop, hop, ribbit!
Can you guess? What other things are green?
A leaf, a frog, and a crunchy green apple!
One more time, nice and loud: GREEN! Great job!
Blue and yellow make green, like the grass and the trees.
Here's a clue: red and blue are going to mix! Can you guess?
Red plus blue makes... Purple! Can you say purple?
Look! A red drop, plus a blue drop, makes a purple drop!
Swirl, swirl, swirl! Red and blue mix together.
Can you reach up high and pick some pretend grapes?
Can you guess? What other things are purple?
Grapes, an eggplant, and a pretty purple flower!
One more time, nice and loud: PURPLE! Great job!
Red and blue make purple. Purple is so pretty!
Here's a clue: red and white are going to mix! Can you guess?
Red plus white makes... Pink! Can you say pink?
Look! A red drop, plus a white drop, makes a pink drop!
Adding white makes a color lighter. Light red is pink!
Can you make a big heart shape with your hands?
Can you guess? What other things are pink?
A flower, a little pig, and a sweet pink heart!
One more time, nice and loud: PINK! Great job!
Red and white make pink. Soft and sweet!
Here's a clue: black and white are going to mix! Can you guess?
Black plus white makes... Gray! Can you say gray?
Look! A black drop, plus a white drop, makes a gray drop!
Gray sits right in the middle of black and white.
Can you stomp like a big gray elephant? Stomp, stomp, stomp!
Can you guess? What other things are gray?
A rain cloud, an elephant, and a smooth gray stone!
One more time, nice and loud: GRAY! Great job!
Black and white make gray, like a cloudy sky.

recap: And black and white make gray!
outro: Ask a grown-up to help you mix some paint, and see what colors you can make.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
